name: Enrich a webinar or event attendee list in Google Sheets with title, company and LinkedIn using looot

parameters.content:
## Enrich webinar and event attendees in Google Sheets

### How it works
1. Paste your attendee export into a sheet named Attendees with an email column, then run the workflow.
2. It picks rows with an email and no enriched_at yet, up to 200 per run.
3. looot looks up the person behind each email: name, job title, company and LinkedIn URL.
4. For work emails, looot also enriches the company from the domain: industry, size and country. Free mail rows skip that step.
5. Every row is written back, so you can sort attendees by title and company size before follow-up.

**Cost per attendee**, from looot's public catalog on 2026-10-31: person from email from $0.0036, company data $0.0019. About $0.0055 for a work email, $0.0036 for free mail. Each call is capped at $0.05, and a failed call costs $0.

### Setup
- Needs the verified community node **n8n-nodes-looot** (built against 0.1.4): Settings > Community nodes > Install, search `looot`. [Install guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/)
- looot: sign up at [looot.ai](https://looot.ai), top up (from $5), create an agent token under Settings > Agent tokens, then add a **looot API** credential in n8n.
- A Google Sheets credential. A sheet named Attendees with the headers: email, full_name, job_title, company, linkedin_url, industry, employees, country, looot_cost_usd, enriched_at. Set the spreadsheet ID in both Sheets nodes.

### Customization
Change MAX in **Attendees to enrich**. Add an IF after **Company fields** to send senior titles to Slack.

## Pick the rows
An email and not enriched yet.

## Person, then company
Company data only for work emails.

## Write the row back
Matched on the sheet's row number.
